verdict.rationale: Check documents creating employees via its API and an official MCP server that lets agents manage employees, so the agent-driven employee-creation part of the story is directly supported. Tax setup, however, is evidenced mainly through the embedded Onboard Component UI, and compensation setup via API is never documented. missing for 10: documented API/MCP creation of compensation (pay rates/earnings), API-driven withholding/W-4 tax setup rather than UI components, an end-to-end agent onboarding walkthrough, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent onboard a new hire end-to-end via the API — creating the employee, compensation, and tax setup
